steps.text: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
choices: I'll help you look for Glough.

steps.text: Climb up into Glough's house south of the Grand Tree.
Climb up to the next floor in Glough's house.
Right-click investigate the tree.
Climb up the tree.
Investigate the nearby statue and turn it.
Search the cupboard.
Search the crates.
Search the fire remains.
Use a pestle and mortar on a lemon
Use the notes on the candles.
Use a pestle and mortar on some grapes.
Use the brush on the note.
Read the note.
Climb down the tree.
Use the translation book on the scrawled note.
Read the translated note.
Talk to Auguste on Entrana. You can take the hot air balloon there from south of the Grand Tree with a log, or travel from Port Sarim.
Return to King Narnode Shareen.
Talk to Garkor on Ape Atoll.
Talk to Awowogei.
choices: I'm here to discuss military strategies.

steps.text: Talk to Garkor again.
Talk to a monkey archer on the west of Ape Atoll. Buy a monkey talisman for 1000 coins now if you need one.
Enter the trapdoor under some grass in the north west of Ape Atoll.
Pick up your greegree!
Search Kruk's Corpse.
Leave the dungeon up the rope to the west.
Enter the dungeon in south Ape Atoll.
Talk to Zooknock in the north east of the dungeon.
Talk to Awowogei as Kruk.
Talk to Garkor on Ape Atoll.
Enter the Troll Stronghold, ready to fight Kob.
Talk to Kob with Protect from Melee on, ready to fight.
choices: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.

steps.text: Fight Kob. He can be safespotted from the doorway.
Talk to Keef in Gu'Tanoth. Get to him via the agility shortcut next to him. Be prepared to fight him and pray Protect from Melee.
choices: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
I offer to spare your life.

steps.text: Talk to Keef in Gu'Tanoth. Be prepared to fight him and pray Protect from Melee.
choices: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
I offer to spare your life.

steps.text: Fight Keef. He can be safespotted.
Talk to Garkor on Ape Atoll.
Search around the various rooftops in Ape Atoll for Assistant Le Smith.
Talk to Assistant Le Smith.
choices: I was going to ask you the same question.
Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships.

steps.text: Talk to Garkor.
Talk to the monkey guard on the north west of Ape Atoll.
choices: I would like to go back to the construction platform.

steps.text: Return to Garkor on Ape Atoll.
Enter the trapdoor under some grass in the north west of Ape Atoll.
Climb across the monkey bars to the north as Kruk.
Enter the passage to the north.
Climb onto the stunted gorilla.
Fight the tortured gorillas. When you're done, be careful NOT to click out of the cutscene or you'll need to do this again.
Dismount the gorilla in the holding area.
Search the crates nearby for a chisel and hammer.
Dismount the gorilla on a holding area and tamper with the device to the north.
Use a chisel on the charged onyx.
Use the onyx back on the device.
Investigate one of the incubation chambers in the room.
Return to Garkor.
Talk to Awowogei.
Talk to Garkor again.
Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Be prepared for fighting, and bring 2 combat styles.
Talk to Nieve south of the Grand Tree. Be prepared to fight with 2 combat styles.
Roam around with Nieve killing the gorillas within the Gnome Stronghold. If you lose Nieve, you can get her again from the Grand Tree.
Enter the breach north west of the Grand Tree with Nieve.
Enter the cavern to the north east.
Talk to Glough in the north of the cavern. After, defeat the tortured and demonic gorillas.
Enter the breach north west of the Grand Tree.

Defeat Glough. He has 3 phases, changing rooms each time. You can safe spot the first 2 phases. Protect from Melee if you're next to him, or Protect from Magic if not in the third phase. The easiest way to do phase 3 is to attack him from 1 tile away, have Protect from Magic on, and step away a tile whenever he pulls you closer.
Talk to Zooknock to teleport to the Grand Tree.
Talk to Narnode to finish the madness!
Investigate the tree in the 2nd floor of Glough's house.
Go talk to Anita in the west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
choices: He might be in trouble, I could help.

steps.text: Return to Glough's house and climb to the 3rd floor.
Go talk to Narnode.
Go talk to Anita in the west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Return to Narnode with the translation.
